Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Besides what I sent on Monday and the 63 pp I am sending by this days post, there are 380 pp of [the Trial](../books.html#53) in type in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), and in MS what I should think would make about 45 or 50 more.
I am writing to [Mrs Blackburn](../persons.html#159) about her drawings
Yours faithfully
C. M.

Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
